PathMilestoneTypeDescriptor.ShortDescription: Foundational course for the chosen field of study
PathMilestoneTypeDescriptor.Description: A core course that provides a foundation for the educator candidate's knowledge and skills in the chosen field of study.

PathMilestoneTypeDescriptor.ShortDescription: Work-based learning with an experienced educator
PathMilestoneTypeDescriptor.Description: A structured learning experience where the educator candidate works alongside an experienced educator in a real-world classroom setting, applying theoretical knowledge and developing practical teaching skills.

PathMilestoneTypeDescriptor.ShortDescription: Assessment evaluation of knowledge and teaching skills
PathMilestoneTypeDescriptor.Description: An assessment evaluation of the educator candidate's knowledge, skills, and understanding of specific subject matter or teaching competencies, such as licensure exams, program assessments, or performance-based assessments.

PathMilestoneTypeDescriptor.ShortDescription: Professional certification in a specific area of education
PathMilestoneTypeDescriptor.Description: A credential or certification obtained by the educator candidate that demonstrates specific knowledge and skills in a particular area of education, such as special education, early childhood education, or English as a Second Language (ESL).

PathMilestoneTypeDescriptor.ShortDescription: Standardized test for licensure or certification
PathMilestoneTypeDescriptor.Description: A standardized exam administered by a state or national agency to assess the educator candidate's knowledge and skills required for licensure or certification in the field of education.

PathMilestoneTypeDescriptor.ShortDescription: Supervised teaching experience in a classroom
PathMilestoneTypeDescriptor.Description: A supervised teaching experience in a real-world classroom setting where the educator candidate applies theoretical knowledge and skills under the guidance of a mentor teacher. This experience is a critical component of the teacher preparation program.

PathMilestoneTypeDescriptor.ShortDescription: Required coursework in the education program
PathMilestoneTypeDescriptor.Description: A specific course within the educator preparation program, covering a range of topics relevant to the field of education, such as pedagogy, curriculum development, classroom management, and special education.

PathMilestoneTypeDescriptor.ShortDescription: Continuing professional education course for educators
PathMilestoneTypeDescriptor.Description: Continuing professional education courses or workshops designed to enhance the educator candidate's knowledge and skills beyond the initial teacher preparation program, such as specialized training in instructional technology, differentiated instruction, or culturally responsive teaching.

The official document awarded to the educator candidate upon successful completion of all the requirements of the teacher preparation program, signifying their readiness to enter the teaching profession.

Specific documents or files that the educator candidate must submit as part of the teacher preparation program, such as transcripts, background checks, licensure applications, or professional portfolios.
Prior work experience in a relevant field, such as tutoring, mentoring, or working with youth, that can enhance the educator candidate's understanding of diverse learners and classroom dynamics.

PathMilestoneTypeDescriptor.ShortDescription: Endorsement to teach a specific subject
PathMilestoneTypeDescriptor.Description: An endorsement or authorization to teach a specific subject area or grade level, which may be added to the educator candidate's teaching license upon successful completion of additional coursework or assessments.

PathMilestoneTypeDescriptor.ShortDescription: Practical experience in an educational setting
PathMilestoneTypeDescriptor.Description: Practical experience in a real-world educational setting, such as observing classrooms, assisting teachers, or participating in school-based activities, providing the educator candidate with valuable insights into the teaching profession.
Recognition of outstanding academic achievement or professional accomplishments by the educator candidate.

PathMilestoneTypeDescriptor.ShortDescription: Culminating project demonstrating skills and knowledge
PathMilestoneTypeDescriptor.Description: A culminating project undertaken by the educator candidate that demonstrates their ability to apply knowledge and skills learned throughout the teacher preparation program, such as developing a curriculum unit, conducting research, or creating a professional portfolio.

Community service activities undertaken by the educator candidate, such as tutoring, mentoring, or volunteering in schools or community organizations, which provide valuable experience in working with diverse populations and fostering a sense of social responsibility.

PathMilestoneTypeDescriptor.ShortDescription: Specialized training on teaching skills or areas
PathMilestoneTypeDescriptor.Description: Training sessions or workshops focused on specific teaching skills or areas of expertise, such as technology integration, classroom management strategies, or special education instructional methods.
